outputs.explanation: This is a native MS deconvoluted mass spectrum (intensity vs. mass) from a single measurement with a table of peak masses/intensities; it is not a bar chart of averaged/replicated data, so individual point overlay is not applicable.
Same as panel A: a single deconvoluted mass spectrum, not an averaged summary statistic requiring individual data points.

Bar chart shows the proportion of protein bound to 0-3 Cd atoms as determined from a single native MS measurement (no error bars, no indication of averaging across replicates), so it is not a mean/median plot requiring individual data points.
Bar chart shows proportions of Zn-bound species from a single native MS determination, not an averaged statistic across replicates, so individual data points are not applicable.
Bar chart shows proportions of Cu-bound species from a single native MS determination, not a mean with variability across replicates.
Bar chart shows proportions of Mn-bound species from a single native MS determination, not an averaged measure requiring individual points.

Bar chart shows single chemical shift perturbation (CSP) values per residue at three defined metal equivalents (0.4, 1.0, 2), not averages of replicate measurements, so overlay of individual points is not applicable.
Same as panel G: single CSP values per residue at defined zinc/cadmium equivalents, not replicate-averaged data requiring individual point overlay.
